newsitem.title: CANADA: Rayrock Yellowknife to up gold output.
newsitem.headline: Rayrock Yellowknife to up gold output.

text.p: Rayrock Yellowknife Resources Inc said on Friday it planned to expand two of its Nevada mines and increase 1997 gold production by 17 percent.
Rayrock said the planned expansion of the Marigold and Dee mines and the start of commercial production at the new Daisy mine would increase its 1997 gold production to 123,000 ounces.
Rayrock said its estimated 1996 gold production was about 105,000 ounces.
"We are in a relatively unexplored area that Rayrock believes has good potential for discovering new gold deposits," said David Hutton, executive vice-president of Rayrock.
